description: This file defines the NodeCapabilityRouter class, which manages routing for node capabilities by mapping commands to handlers and processing requests asynchronously.

classes.name: NodeCapabilityRouter
classes.description: A final class that routes commands to their respective handlers in an asynchronous manner, supporting error handling for unknown commands.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the NodeCapabilityRouter with a dictionary of command handlers.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming requests by invoking the appropriate handler asynchronously, throwing an error if the command is unknown.
